question:
A nucleus $P$ undergoes $\beta^-$ decay:

$$P \rightarrow D + e^- + \bar\nu$$

Atomic masses (including electrons) are given:

$$M(P)=31.973907\,u,\qquad M(D)=31.972071\,u$$

Take $1u\,c^2=931.5\,\text{MeV}$. Ignore the tiny recoil energy of the daughter nucleus.

(a) Calculate the $Q$-value of the decay.</br>
(b) Estimate the maximum kinetic energy of the emitted electron.</br>
